_comment: Equipment of the Player's Handbook (2024), PDF pages 216-236, and the Trinkets table (pages 49-50): weapons, mastery properties, armour, tools, adventuring gear, mounts, vehicles and services. Names, pages and classification only.

entries.name: Lance
entries.note: adapted: always two-handed for now; held in one hand from the saddle when mounted combat comes (Expansion 9)

entries.name: Musket
entries.note: adapted (section 1.3): rare gnomish work, never in ordinary shops, starting kits or common loot

entries.name: Pistol
entries.note: adapted (section 1.3): rare gnomish work, never in ordinary shops, starting kits or common loot

entries.name: Book
entries.note: a book is lore or history in the game

entries.name: Chest
entries.note: adapted: a carried chest adds to what you can carry

entries.name: Diplomat's Pack
entries.note: ink and the five pens are one ink and quill; paper and parchment are both parchment (ten sheets); the chest is left out

entries.name: Druidic Focus
entries.note: works with the druid (expansion 3)

entries.name: Ink
entries.note: ink and pen are one item

entries.name: Ink Pen
entries.note: ink and pen are one item

entries.name: Paper
entries.note: paper and parchment are one item

entries.name: Scholar's Pack
entries.note: the book is left out (a book is lore or history in the game); ink and pen are one ink and quill; ten sheets of parchment

entries.name: Druidic Focus (Sprig of Mistletoe)
entries.note: works with the druid (expansion 3)

entries.name: Druidic Focus (Wooden Staff)
entries.note: works with the druid (expansion 3)

entries.name: Druidic Focus (Yew Wand)
entries.note: works with the druid (expansion 3)

entries.name: Barding
entries.note: moved: armour for a mount matters once mounts fight (mounted combat, expansion 9)

entries.name: Saddle, Exotic
entries.note: adapted: the seat on an elephant's back; flying and swimming mounts come later

entries.name: Saddle, Military
entries.note: adapted: a saddle for now; staying mounted in a fight comes with mounted combat (expansion 9)

entries.name: Airship
entries.note: airborne, but printed in the same table as the ships; delivered with the large vehicles of 22

entries.name: Lifestyle (Wretched)
entries.note: adapted: living wretched is sleeping rough, in camp or under the town walls; an inn offers squalid and up

entries.name: Coach Ride within a City
entries.note: adapted: coaches run between towns; a city's map is walked

entries.name: Skilled Hireling
entries.note: adapted: skilled hirelings are hired companions, whose wage (data/companions.json) is below 2 gp a day because they share the loot too

entries.name: Untrained Hireling
entries.note: adapted: the player works as an untrained hireling (a day's labour pays 2 sp); hired porters are pack animals

entries.name: Spellcasting Service (Cantrip)
entries.note: a temple priest (cleric list) or a mage (wizard list) casts what helps the party; reach by place and caster; price plus costly component
